question: Who designed the 'Statue of Unity', which was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 31st October 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ram Vanji Sutar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Statue of Unity **is the **world's tallest statue**.
 
• Its **height **is **182 meters**.
 
• It is **located **in the **state of Gujarat, India**.
 
• It depicts **Indian statesman **and **independence activist Vallabhbhai Patel**.
 
• **He **was the **first deputy prime minister **and **home minister **of **independent India **and an **adherent of Mahatma Gandhi**.
 
• **Ram Vanji Sutar **is an **Indian sculptor**. He **designed **the **Statue of Unity **which is the **world's tallest statue **with a **height of 182 metres**, **exceeding **the **Spring Temple Buddha by 54 metres**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishna Reddy **was an **Indian master printmaker**, **sculptor**, and **teacher**. He was **considered a master intaglio printer **and known for **viscosity printing**.
 
• **Ramkinkar Baij **was an **Indian sculptor **and **painter**, one of the pioneers of **modern Indian sculpture **and a **key figure of Contextual Modernism.**
